summary: Learn Data Mesh, domain ownership, and federated governance with practical templates, exercises, and roadmap design. Enroll today.
lede: Data Mesh and Domain-Oriented Data Governance provides a decentralized approach to organizing ownership around business domains, treating data as a product, and coordinating enterprise controls through federated governance. It helps you connect domain boundaries, reliable data products, policy enforcement, lineage visibility, and accountability into a coherent operating model. Through practical exercises, you will develop artefacts such as a domain inventory, data product canvas, policy matrix, and operating model draft while assessing maturity and mapping governance decisions. You will also explore readiness evaluation, evolution metrics, and self-serve platform design patterns to create a realistic adoption roadmap that fits legacy dependencies, budget constraints, and competing priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape data ownership, governance, and delivery across business domains and need a practical operating model for Data Mesh adoption.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include working familiarity with enterprise data governance, data architecture, or data management concepts; experience reading data models, business glossaries, or governance policies; and the ability to participate in domain mapping and operating model workshops. No coding is required for completion, although familiarity with SQL, catalog tools, or analytics dashboards will help you engage more deeply with the practical exercises. Advanced implementation topics such as self-serve platform design are taught at the operational application level, while roadmap and governance design are handled at a practical planning level.
